stations.title: Dougie
stations.say: How many packs do I open tonight?

stations.title: Envelope
stations.text: Sums done by hand, one pack too many.

stations.title: Kit store
stations.text: The right packs on the bench, none spare.

captions: Thursday at the kit store. Dougie is filling head torches before the night exercise.
Today Dougie works it out on an envelope and opens one pack too many.
You write the sums: batteries, full packs, loose batteries and the walk in.
Now the laptop says how many packs to open and how long the walk will take.
Numbers, kept as names and worked out the same way every time.
